text: Elica S.p.A. is listed on Euronext STAR Milan; its majority shareholder is F.A.N. S.r.l. with 52.81%, which Elica's investor page marks as a company attributable to the Casoli family (update of 22 December 2025).
short: Elica is listed in Milan; 52.81% held by the Casoli family's F.A.N. S.r.l.
